title: Boxes Are Overflowing
environment: Warehouse — silo fill cell, west bay
briefing: It fills, then keeps filling. Product all over the floor by the time anyone noticed.

tags.label: STOP_PB
tags.description: Stop pushbutton, momentary NC in field

tags.label: PROX_SENSOR
tags.description: Inductive prox — carton present under silo spout

tags.label: MODE_SEL
tags.description: A/B/C mode selector — declared so the cell’s writes land on a real tag; no rung consumes it yet

rungs.description: Start/stop seal-in. RUN latches on START, drops on STOP or E-STOP.
rungs.condition: (I:1/00 OR O:2/02) AND NOT I:1/01 AND NOT I:1/02

rungs.description: Motor runs whenever RUN is on and the valve is shut.
Valve opens with a carton at the prox and the box not yet full.
rungs.condition: O:2/02 AND I:1/03 AND NOT I:1/04

rungs.description: FULL lamp follows the level sensor.

faults.effect: The through-beam level photo-eye has lost its signal — the receiver cable is broken where it flexes at the cable chain. The input never makes, so the valve is never told to shut. The carton overfills, and because the motor rung is interlocked against the valve the belt cannot index the box away either.
clues: FILL lamp stays lit and product keeps running long after the carton is full.
FULL lamp never lights, on any box.
I:1/04 stays FALSE at the processor even with the beam deliberately blocked by hand.
The conveyor is dead while the valve is open — correct, the motor rung is interlocked against it.
The receiver cable is stiff and the outer sheath is split where it enters the cable chain.
faults.solution: Lock out the cell, then replace the damaged length of level-sensor cable and re-support it so it flexes at a radius the chain can take. The sensor and the program are both healthy — this is a broken conductor.

redHerrings.description: The fine-grade product is dustier and coats everything.
redHerrings.whyMisleading: The changeover is coincidental. A dusty lens would give an intermittent signal, not a permanently dead one.

redHerrings.description: The solenoid valve body is warm.
redHerrings.whyMisleading: Expected — it has been held open continuously. It is the symptom, not the cause.

derekScript.initialCall: We're wearing product. Boxes are overflowing and the line just sits there.
derekScript.checkIn5min: How long? I’ve got someone sweeping it up.
derekScript.impatient10min: Just close the valve manually and we’ll run it by hand.
derekScript.resolution: A broken wire in the drag chain. That would do it.
